newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - June 12.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - June 12.

text.p: -- Thyssen AG said it signed a definitive pact to buy U.S. machine tools maker Giddings & Lewis Inc for $21 cash per share, or about $675 million.
-- The chief financial officer of International Business Machines Corp, Richard Thoman, is expected to resign today, according to the Wall Street Journal.
-- Polo Ralph Lauren Corp sold shares for $26 each in the second largest initial public offering this year, raising about $767 million.
-- Archer Daniels Midland Co said it is among the targets of a European probe into possible anti-competitive practices.
-- Bottler Coca-Cola Enterprises may seek to increase prices after July 4, ending a heated soda price war, the Wall Street Journal reported.

-- News Corp Ltd signed two deals worth a total of almost $3.0 billion. It will sell its American Sky Broadcasting satellite assets to Primestar Partner LP in exchange for equity, and buy cable network International Family Entertainment.
